# Calculating LLM Cost & Estimation Strategies — delivery kit

*Product owners, engineers, finance partners · 4 hours · level 1 · certification: aware*

| What | Where | Edit it |

## You will be able to

- Estimate cost of any GenAI feature before launch
- Explain tokens and pricing to non-technical stakeholders
- Apply the three cost controls
- Monitor cost per request

## Demos

| # | Demo | Module | Min | Shows |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `01_billing_unit_and_formula.py` | 1+2 | 15 | text → tokens → dollars: input vs output vs cached input, then one request built up line by line (system + context + history + question + answer) |
| 2 | `02_volume_and_growth.py` | 3 | 12 | how an untrimmed conversation grows cost quadratically turn by turn, and what 'just use the best model for everything' does to the monthly bill |
| 3 | `03_cost_a_feature_sensitivity.py` | 4 | 20 | one feature costed as basic, RAG and agentic designs using cost_calculator.py, then a tornado-style sensitivity showing which assumption moves the bill most |
| 4 | `04_three_point_estimate.py` | 5 | 15 | three estimation methods applied to the same feature, reconciled into a three-point (PERT) range with a confidence statement you can put in a proposal |
| 5 | `05_controls_and_alerts.py` | 6 | 12 | the four standard controls with their typical saving on this workload, and a per-request cost alert catching a runaway request before the invoice does |

## Run of show
**One week before:** `python demos/run_all.py` on the laptop you will present from — it must print `ALL DEMOS OK`. Swap `demos/data/` for the client's own examples where you can. Print `exercises.md` per table and the handout per person.
**In the room:** each demo is one command from this folder: `python demos/NN_name.py`. No internet or API key needed. Each ends with a *Say it* line — your closing sentence.
**Live mode:** set `LLM_PROVIDER` and a key in the repo `.env`; demos that benefit then call a real model.
**In the browser:** every demo also runs from the `/demos` page (section *Course labs*) — useful for sales calls and the website.
